first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: The low-profile yellow sports car that remains centered in close-up from a trailing viewpoint, with a dark rear panel, a large red rear wing, and four red ring-shaped taillights.

entities.name: Vehicle B
entities.identification: The low-profile white sports car that remains on the racetrack ahead of Vehicle A, with a dark horizontal area at the rear and red taillight points.

entities.name: racetrack surface
entities.identification: The broad gray paved surface extending from the lower part of the image toward the distant orange-lit tunnel entrance.

entities.name: sky
entities.identification: The blue-gray sky above the trees and in the central gap, brighter lower down.

entities.name: orange-lit tunnel entrance
entities.identification: The arched entrance between the trees at the far end of the racetrack, with a gray exterior, an orange-yellow bright area inside, and a dark interior area left of center.

entities.name: Vehicle C
entities.identification: The white pickup truck outside the barrier on the left, with dark windows, a red area at the front, and a red stripe along the side.

entities.name: group of staff in orange
entities.identification: The group of staff in orange distributed within the separated areas on both sides of the racetrack, with the members on the left near Vehicle C.

entities.name: concrete racetrack barrier
entities.identification: The low gray walls extending along both sides of the racetrack, with long wall sections and continuous upper edges.

entities.name: racetrack safety fence
entities.identification: The gray mesh fencing outside the barriers, supported by repeating slender posts.

entities.name: trees around the outside of the racetrack
entities.identification: The dense dark-green trees surrounding both sides of the racetrack and the distant background, with irregular canopy outlines.

entities.name: roadside lattice tower
entities.identification: The partially visible slender gray lattice tower body at the upper-right edge at the beginning of the clip, with repeating diagonal bracing.

entities.name: roadside grass
entities.identification: The narrow strip of green grass between the left barrier and the white racetrack edge line at the beginning of the clip.
